reviews.text: I had a large back patio  screened in with a door and it turned out better than we could have imagined.  From the time they came out for an estimate to the installation they were very professional.  The installers were amazing and did a great job.  I would highly recommend this company.
reviews.author: Teresa Hove

reviews.text:
They just finished installing a custom designed patio roof on our house.  They did the design and installation and it looks fabulous!
The installers were very meticulous with all their measurements and very professional and easy to work with.
reviews.author: Richard Hicks

reviews.text: Bought a very expensive cover for my back patio (8k) because I wanted it to look nice.  They have come back out several times to fix and they keep telling me it’s not the cover it’s the roof.  My patio furniture is getting wet every time it rains. Leaking in three different spots. Now I’ve decided to just have it redone by someone else. 8k down the drain. Wouldn’t recommend.
reviews.author: Jeff Freeman

data.summary: The review profile is concerning. While a long operational history is evident, the severe, repeated complaint pattern about leaking covers and failed repairs is highly credible and specific. The positive reviews are often too vague to counter these detailed complaints, and the company's own review among the positives is a red flag. The rating discrepancy and lack of substantive positive detail suggest potential review manipulation or a business with significant quality control issues.
fake_signals: Multiple 5-star Google reviews are extremely brief/vague (e.g., 'Love the people', 'The peoplr were so nice')
One 5-star Google review is from the company itself
Two HQ Google reviews are anonymous with no substantive content
Lack of detailed, specific positive reviews to counter severe complaints
authentic_signals: Negative reviews contain specific, credible details (project cost $8k, leaking in three spots, two repair attempts)
Reviews span a long timeframe (8 years)
Some positive reviews mention specific project types (screened-in patio, custom patio roof)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant discrepancy between Google (3.8) and Yelp (4.6) ratings. Google reviews show specific, severe complaints about leaks and unresolved issues, while Yelp's higher rating lacks visible review content for verification.
